beats.text: Polly stands with her flippers clasped under her chin, gazing to the right with a worried look and blushing cheeks
Polly squeezes her eyes shut and turns to face the other way, hugging her belly
Polly looks off to the left with anxious eyes, her flippers wrapped around her belly
Polly shuts her eyes and turns back toward the right
Polly clasps her flippers under her chin again and gazes to the right with a worried look

spans.notes: fully plain ground: only Polly and her shadow. Her bounding box stays at x 266-714 / y 733-1381 (height 634-648 px) through f71, shifting only with her own pose changes; from f72 the whole picture translates rigidly (-10, -33, -63, -105 px...) = start of the whip. Judged static per the plain-ground ruling. No caption or watermark.
whip-pan transition: Polly's picture eases out to the left f72-76, Pax's doorway scene slides in f77 and eases to rest (wall template x +238, +138, +71, +30, +7 px at f78-82; 0 from f83).

real brand: the parcels Pax carries (and later sets on the floor) are brown boxes with blue tape and the Amazon smile-arrow logo, legible on every frame f83-199 (label POLLY on them too). Content: Pax in a black tie stands at an igloo door holding the parcels and a briefcase (static f83-~138), the camera then pulls back and shifts (~f139-168) to a wide view with Polly standing at the left; Pax sets the parcels down and leaves through the door, a red sled passes the window. One run, one reason (ad_merch outranks camera_move).
